title: A compatible pair of tower counits lifts across the signed cover
statement: Use the coefficient, field, ordinary derived tower and exact open-operation setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf], [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus] and [lem-sp-tower-binary-ctf-fibre], with open-counit data [def-sp-tower-binary-open-counit-data]. Fix h:Z→Y, compactification c, a binary cover Z=U∪V, good K,P,Q and representing counits eU,eV, with compact support preserving the good subcategories as in the parent statement. Suppose cW:P|W≅Q|W preserves the restricted counits. For any good G with restriction isomorphisms aU,aV satisfying the displayed restrictionComp overlap equation with cW, there exists e:F_Z G→K satisfying both LiftEquations. Furthermore F_Z(coverS G) followed by beta(eU,eV,aU,aV) is zero, and every e satisfying LiftEquations obeys F_Z(coverT G) followed by e = beta. No claim of global representability is made.

proof.text:
For a tower complex $M$ put $A_M=j_{W!}(M|_W)$, $B_M=j_{U!}(M|_U)\oplus j_{V!}(M|_V)$. The sequence-topos localization of [lem-pur-sequence-site-open-extension], with coefficient rings $A_n$, identifies these with the slice-topos operations. The constant subterminals $U,V$ cover the terminal sequence, as their union is terminal at every level, and their intersection is $W$. Clause (2) of [lem-sp-ringed-topos-binary-descent] therefore gives
$$A_M\xrightarrow{s_M=(1,-1)}B_M\xrightarrow{t_M=(1,1)}M\xrightarrow{\delta_M}A_M[1].$$
All these objects are in $\mathcal C_Z$ when $M$ is, by exact open extension from [lem-sp-coefficient-tower-shriek-calculus]; finite sums and shifts preserve the defining uniform intervals (take the union of the two intervals). The calculus makes $F_Z$ exact and identifies $F_Zj_{D!}$ with $F_D$, including the nested-open maps and counits.

proof.text:
Use the given $G,a_U,a_V$ and define $\beta:F_ZB_G\to K$ by its components $\beta_D=\epsilon_D F_D(a_D)$ for $D=U,V$. Step 2 and $a_V|_W=c\,a_U|_W$ give
$$\beta F_Z(s_G)=e_P F_W(a_U|_W)-e_Q F_W(a_V|_W)=0.$$
Here step 3 identifies both summands with maps from $F_W(G|_W)$; the minus sign is exactly that of $s_G$. Apply clause (i) of [lem-weil-pbc-hom-out-of-triangle-exact] to the distinguished image triangle $F_ZA_G\to F_ZB_G\to F_ZG\to F_ZA_G[1]$. It supplies $\epsilon:F_ZG\to K$ with $\epsilon F_Z(t_G)=\beta$. Restricting this equality to the two summands gives both required local equations and proves the stated factorization.

proof.text: Conversely expand coverT as the two actual counits and beta as the sum of the images of the two projections. Additivity and the two LiftEquations give the factorization for every lift.

theorem compatible_counit_lift
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p) (hlp : l ≠ p)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (Z Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [IsSeparated Z.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Z.hom] [QuasiCompact Z.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom] [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    (h : Z ⟶ Y) (c₀ : Compactification h.left)
    (U V : Z.left.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (_hF : ∀ M : D l E Z.left, good l E b q Z.left M →
      good l E b q Y.left ((F l E b o c₀).obj M))
    (_hFD : ∀ (D₀ : Z.left.Opens) (N : D l E D₀.toScheme),
      good l E b q D₀.toScheme N →
      good l E b q Y.left ((support l E b o c₀ D₀).obj N))
    (K : D l E Y.left) (_hK : good l E b q Y.left K)
    (P : D l E U.toScheme) (_hP : good l E b q U.toScheme P)
    (Q : D l E V.toScheme) (_hQ : good l E b q V.toScheme Q)
    (eU : (support l E b o c₀ U).obj P ⟶ K)
    (eV : (support l E b o c₀ V).obj Q ⟶ K)
    (hU : Represents l E b q (support l E b o c₀ U) P K eU)
    (hV : Represents l E b q (support l E b o c₀ V) Q K eV)
    (c : (restrictionBetween l E b o (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)).obj P ≅
      (restrictionBetween l E b o (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)).obj Q)
    (hc : (support l E b o c₀ (U ⊓ V)).map c.hom ≫
        restrictedCounit l E b o c₀ (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V) Q K eV =
      restrictedCounit l E b o c₀ (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U) P K eU)
    (G : D l E Z.left) (hG : good l E b q Z.left G)
    (aU : (restriction l E b o U).obj G ≅ P)
    (aV : (restriction l E b o V).obj G ≅ Q)
    (hcompat : (restrictionComp l E b o (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)).hom.app G ≫
        (restrictionBetween l E b o (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U)).map aU.hom ≫ c.hom =
      (restrictionComp l E b o (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)).hom.app G ≫
        (restrictionBetween l E b o (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V)).map aV.hom) :
    (∃ e : (F l E b o c₀).obj G ⟶ K,
      LiftEquations l E b o c₀ U V eU eV aU aV e) ∧
    (F l E b o c₀).map (coverS l E b o U V G) ≫
      beta l E b o c₀ U V eU eV aU aV = 0 ∧
    ∀ e : (F l E b o c₀).obj G ⟶ K,
      LiftEquations l E b o c₀ U V eU eV aU aV e →
      (F l E b o c₀).map (coverT l E b o U V G) ≫ e =
        beta l E b o c₀ U V eU eV aU aV
